texts.author: apex_concierge
texts.text: We only handle orders placed with Apex Hyperstore here, so we cannot cancel or refund an Amazon order for you. If you need help with an order, a product, or a return from Apex Hyperstore instead, please let us know and we'll be happy to assist you!
